risks.risk: Brake stopping power may be weak (pads/rotors/cables worn or misadjusted).
risks.proof: Short video of a brake test (slow ride + hard front and rear braking) and close-up photos of front/rear brake parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (assume needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may be rough (derailleur alignment/cable stretch/worn chain/cassette).
risks.proof: Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus close-up of rear derailleur and shifter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears not confirmed (assume needs adjustment/maintenance).

risks.risk: Tire wear/sidewall cracks/repairs may exist despite the bike looking clean.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and valve/inner tube area if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires may need replacement/repair.

risks.risk: Hidden frame/fork/wheel alignment issues (bent wheel, headset/fork problems).
risks.proof: Photos of wheels straight-on and from the side, plus a video rolling straight and steering smoothly.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing even if seller says “complete accessories.”
risks.proof: Photos of every included accessory laid out (lights, pump, lock, tools, reflectors, etc.) with a checklist.
